Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 712 AM EDT Wed Oct 14 2026

- Temperatures closer to normal and drier today, followed by 
  additional rainfall late Thursday afternoon into early Friday 
  morning.

- A strong cold front delivers gusty winds and much chillier 
 conditions Friday, with a few showers in spots.

- Turning drier through the weekend with slightly warmer readings by
  Sunday.

&&

.AVIATION...

Cold front has settled just south of Michigan to start this TAF 
period with just higher coverage of shower activity along the state 
line now pushing east. Expecting a mix of MVFR and low VFR clouds 
this morning with a lifting to predominately SCT/BKN low VFR for the 
remainder of the day. Light NNW winds veer to the N-NE by this 
evening with a high pressure building across the northern Great 
Lakes, which will also supply the drier air to help improve the 
ceilings this afternoon. It appears northeasterly winds for tonight 
will help bring a return to greater coverage of Lake Huron stratus 
that brings a return to SCT to BKN MVFR ceilings. 

D21/DTW Convection...No thunderstorms today or tonight.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* High for ceilings at or below 5,000 feet this morning. Medium for 
  this afternoon.
